sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and resource sectors dominate market breadth, led by Energy's sustained command across all time horizons, while cyclical and communication groups deteriorate.

Market leadership is highly concentrated in a narrow, defensive-tilted cohort, with only 3 of 11 sectors showing positive returns across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD. Energy firmly anchors the market at the top spot with a dominant 0.967 momentum score, accompanied by steady inflows into Healthcare and Consumer Defensive. 

Conversely, cyclical exposure continues to fade. Communication Services sits at the bottom with a 0.167 momentum score, while Basic Materials dropped a spot to rank 5. Short-term rotations favor safety, with slight upward adjustments in Healthcare and Utilities against a backdrop of broader structural weakness in low-momentum sectors.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 3 of 11 groups are all-green across all evaluated periods: Energy (momentum 0.97), Healthcare (momentum 0.85), and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.70).
- **Energy Dominance:** Energy is the sole sustained strong sector, maintaining a top-3 ranking across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons while holding the #1 YTD rank with a 0.967 momentum score.
- **Defensive Anchors:** Consumer Defensive (rank 3, momentum 0.700) and Healthcare (rank 4, momentum 0.850) solidify high-momentum positioning behind the lead.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Short-Term Gainers:** Over the last 5 sessions, Healthcare and Utilities each improved +1 spot to reach ranks 4 and 9, respectively.
- **Underperformers Falling:** Basic Materials fell -1 spot to rank 5 (momentum 0.350), while Communication Services slid -1 spot to rank 10 with a market-low momentum score of 0.167.
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical languishes at rank 11 with a 0.333 momentum score, alongside Industrials at rank 6 (0.300 momentum) and Utilities at rank 9 (0.350 momentum).

## Divergences
- **Technology Rank vs. Momentum:** Technology holds the #2 YTD rank, yet its momentum score has softened to 0.633, trailing lower-ranked Healthcare (rank 4, momentum 0.850) and Consumer Defensive (rank 3, momentum 0.700).
- **Basic Materials Erosion:** Despite maintaining a middle-tier YTD position at rank 5, Basic Materials reflects weak underlying support with a 0.350 momentum score and a 1-spot loss over the past 5 sessions.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and business services dominate leadership with broad momentum, while metals, mining, and industrial cyclicals suffer severe five-day rank deterioration.

Market leadership remains heavily anchored in energy and healthcare, supported by a solid core of 32 all-green industries out of 144. Oil & Gas Integrated (0.917 momentum) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.889 momentum) continue to demonstrate multi-timeframe dominance alongside sustained performers like Health Information Services and Department Stores. Concurrently, commercial and consumer services are rotating higher, evidenced by sharp weekly rank jumps in Staffing & Employment Services and Rental & Leasing Services.

Conversely, basic materials and heavy industrials are fading rapidly. Metal Fabrication, Silver, Engineering & Construction, and Gold all plunged 30 or more spots in the rankings over the last five sessions, coupled with deeply suppressed momentum scores. Meanwhile, alternative energy and power generation remain pinned at the bottom, with Uranium (0.072 momentum) and Renewable Utilities (0.125 momentum) anchoring the market's weakest tier.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** 32 of 144 groups maintain positive performance across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD frames, led by Oil & Gas Integrated (0.92 momentum), Oil & Gas E&P (0.89), and Staffing & Employment Services (0.89).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Groups sustaining top-36 rankings across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons include Oil & Gas Integrated, Oil & Gas E&P, Department Stores, Health Information Services, Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, Medical Care Facilities, Medical Distribution, and Software - Application.
- **Top Momentum Anchors:** Oil & Gas Integrated (0.917, rank 4 YTD) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.889, rank 7 YTD) hold the highest overall momentum profiles in the market.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Accelerating Rank Gainers:** Department Stores surged +19 spots to rank 46 (0.87 momentum), Rental & Leasing Services jumped +18 spots to rank 45 (0.60 momentum), and Waste Management climbed +18 spots to rank 60 (0.77 momentum).
- **Aggressive Unwinding:** Metal Fabrication plummeted -43 spots to rank 91 (0.20 momentum), Silver dropped -34 spots to rank 79 (0.34 momentum), and Engineering & Construction fell -31 spots to rank 82 (0.18 momentum).
- **Entrenched Laggards:** Weakest momentum scores remain concentrated in Uranium (0.072), Advertising Agencies (0.079, rank 144 YTD), Resorts & Casinos (0.093), and Independent Power Producers (0.110).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Tobacco (0.64 momentum, -4 spots in 5d), Insurance - Reinsurance (0.76 momentum, -2 spots in 5d), and Medical Distribution (0.75 momentum, -2 spots in 5d) are showing early signs of rank slippage despite elevated momentum.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Early rank improvements are appearing in beaten-down housing and real estate pockets, including REIT - Office (+10 spots in 5d, 0.44 momentum), Residential Construction (+8 spots, 0.43 momentum), and Home Improvement Retail (+7 spots, 0.43 momentum).
- **Fragile Leader:** Diagnostics & Research is designated as a fragile all-green group due to rank instability, registering a low agreement score of 0.50.
